data.body:
[P1] Require reconciliation for unjournaled invocations

If collection returns invocation attempts but the adapter omitted `record_attempt`, ownership validation rejects the evidence, yet this empty-journal guard skips independent retirement auditing. Final validation is also skipped because the case no longer passes. Consequently, `retire` returning `True` releases the target without proving those executions settled. Require reconciliation whenever evidence reveals launched work, and quarantine invocations that cannot be bound to the journal. Add a regression with an empty journal and nonempty collected attempts.
